notes: Fixed fabricated per-customer counts in TAM Recommendations (e.g. 'Support and Entitlements: 1 of 6 systems'). Active IQ scores each check per Active IQ account (the whole reseller/MSP tenant), not per customer -- the app was multiplying that one account-wide percentage by each individual customer's system count to synthesize a fake per-customer figure, so every customer with the same system count showed the identical number regardless of their actual data. Confirmed live: 5 real customers all showing the same fabricated '1 of 6' for EOS_6M actually have 0, 0, 0, 0, and 2 systems truly reaching End of Support within 6 months. For the 4 checks with real per-system data (EOS within 6 months, already EOS, contract expiring within 6 months, no active support contract), the app now counts the actual scoped systems from lifecycle.eosDate / contracts.daysRemaining instead of extrapolating. Every other recommendation check has no real per-customer source in the API, so those counts are now explicitly labeled '(est.)' with a tooltip explaining they're extrapolated from the account-wide rate, not measured -- never shown with the confidence of a real measurement again. Applied consistently to the on-screen tab, the Section 12 TXT export, and the QBR Pack deliverable. Also fixed: live ASA r2 systems with no computable SAZ usage data were showing NetApp's marketed 4:1 efficiency SLA as if it were a measured ratio -- now shows N/A, with the SLA claim remaining visible separately via the platform note.
